description:
Proposed 800mm ground-floor rear extension incorporating 1no.rooflight; Proposed 1290mm ground-floor side extension and 1no. partial vertical eaves roof light; Proposed pitched roof to replace existing garage flat roof with 1no rooflight. 

Proposed 3370mm first-floor side extension. Introduction of brick detailing to window sills and low-level ground-floor perimeter, and tudor-style black timber detailing to the first-floor side extension to reflect and complement the existing architectural character of the property; proposed solar panels on the pitched roof.
